title: Minimum Runes to Add to Cast Spell
summary: Alice, after graduating from wizard school, aims to cast a spell.
statement: Alice, after graduating from wizard school, aims to cast a spell. The spell requires focus points, some containing magic crystals as energy sources. Directed runes channel magic between these points. Given the number of focus points, an array of crystals, and two arrays for existing runes, determine the minimum number of new directed runes needed so each focus point either has a crystal or receives magic flow from another point.
constraints: 2 <= n <= 100,000; crystals is nonempty; flow arrays describe up to 200,000 distinct directed edges.
A crystal powers every node reachable along existing directed runes.
Add the fewest directed runes so every node becomes powered.
hints: Contract each unreachable strongly connected component; one entry powers its entire component.
Only zero-indegree components in the unreachable condensation need new incoming runes.
Mark crystal reachability, compute SCCs on the remainder, count condensation components with no incoming edge.
Every source component needs an external entry, and one rune into each source reaches all downstream components.
editorial: Every source component needs an external entry, and one rune into each source reaches all downstream components.

tests.explanation: The four-node cycle is powered; the two isolated points each need one new incoming rune.
The existing chain carries power from the crystal to every focus point, so no rune is added.
